                    const url = "";
                    const revisionId = ;
                    
                    pdfjsLib.GlobalWorkerOptions.workerSrc = 'https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/pdf.js/2.16.105/pdf.worker.min.js';
                    
                    let pdfDoc = null;
                    let pageNum = 1;
                    let canvas = document.getElementById('pdf-canvas');
                    let ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
                    let container = document.getElementById('pdf-container');
                    let scale = 1.2;
                    let viewport = null;
                    
                    let boxes = [];
                    
                    pdfjsLib.getDocument(url).promise.then(function(pdfDoc_) {
                        pdfDoc = pdfDoc_;
                        document.getElementById('page-count').textContent = pdfDoc.numPages;
                        renderPage(pageNum);
                    });
                    
                    function renderPage(num) {
                        pdfDoc.getPage(num).then(function(page) {
                            viewport = page.getViewport({scale: scale});
                            canvas.height = viewport.height;
                            canvas.width = viewport.width;
                            container.style.width = viewport.width + 'px';
                            container.style.height = viewport.height + 'px';
                            
                            var renderContext = {
                                canvasContext: ctx,
                                viewport: viewport
                            };
                            page.render(renderContext);
                            
                            document.getElementById('page-num').textContent = num;
                            
                            // Show only boxes for current page
                            boxes.forEach(box => {
                                if (box.page === num) {
                                    box.element.style.display = 'flex';
                                } else {
                                    box.element.style.display = 'none';
                                }
                            });
                        });
                    }

                    document.getElementById('prev-page').addEventListener('click', function() {
                        if (pageNum <= 1) return;
                        pageNum--;
                        renderPage(pageNum);
                    });

                    document.getElementById('next-page').addEventListener('click', function() {
                        if (pageNum >= pdfDoc.numPages) return;
                        pageNum++;
                        renderPage(pageNum);
                    });
                    
                    container.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
                        if (e.target.classList.contains('signature-box')) return;
                        const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
                        const x = e.clientX - rect.left;
                        const y = e.clientY - rect.top;
                        addBox(x, y);
                    });
                    
                    document.getElementById('add-box-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
                        addBox(viewport.width/2 - 75, viewport.height/2 - 25);
                    });
                    
                    function addBox(x, y) {
                        const select = document.getElementById('user-select');
                        const userId = select.value;
                        const userName = select.options[select.selectedIndex].text;
                        
                        const boxDiv = document.createElement('div');
                        boxDiv.className = 'signature-box';
                        boxDiv.style.left = x + 'px';
                        boxDiv.style.top = y + 'px';
                        boxDiv.innerText = userName;
                        container.appendChild(boxDiv);
                        
                        const boxId = boxes.length;
                        
                        boxes.push({
                            id: boxId,
                            x: x,
                            y: y,
                            page: pageNum,
                            userId: userId,
                            userName: userName,
                            element: boxDiv
                        });
                        
                        updateBoxList();
                        makeDraggable(boxDiv, boxId);
                    }
                    
                    function updateBoxList() {
                        const list = document.getElementById('box-list');
                        list.innerHTML = '';
                        boxes.forEach((box, index) => {
                            const li = document.createElement('li');
                            li.className = 'list-group-item d-flex justify-content-between align-items-center';
                            li.innerText = box.userName + " (Page " + box.page + ")";
                            const btn = document.createElement('button');
                            btn.className = 'btn btn-sm btn-danger';
                            btn.innerText = 'X';
                            btn.onclick = () => {
                                box.element.remove();
                                boxes.splice(index, 1);
                                updateBoxList();
                            };
                            li.appendChild(btn);
                            list.appendChild(li);
                        });
                    }
                    
                    function makeDraggable(elmnt, boxId) {
                        var pos1 = 0, pos2 = 0, pos3 = 0, pos4 = 0;
                        elmnt.onmousedown = dragMouseDown;
                        
                        function dragMouseDown(e) {
                            e = e || window.event;
                            e.preventDefault();
                            pos3 = e.clientX;
                            pos4 = e.clientY;
                            document.onmouseup = closeDragElement;
                            document.onmousemove = elementDrag;
                        }
                        
                        function elementDrag(e) {
                            e = e || window.event;
                            e.preventDefault();
                            pos1 = pos3 - e.clientX;
                            pos2 = pos4 - e.clientY;
                            pos3 = e.clientX;
                            pos4 = e.clientY;
                            elmnt.style.top = (elmnt.offsetTop - pos2) + "px";
                            elmnt.style.left = (elmnt.offsetLeft - pos1) + "px";
                            
                            boxes.find(b => b.id === boxId).x = elmnt.offsetLeft;
                            boxes.find(b => b.id === boxId).y = elmnt.offsetTop;
                        }
                        
                        function closeDragElement() {
                            document.onmouseup = null;
                            document.onmousemove = null;
                        }
                    }
                    
                    document.getElementById('save-btn').addEventListener('click', function() {
                        const payload = boxes.map(b => {
                            // Convert HTML y to PDF y (bottom-up). ReportLab uses bottom-up coordinates.
                            // However, we can just pass the scale and HTML coordinates to the backend
                            // and let the backend do the math, OR do it here.
                            // The backend assumes A4 (595x842) by default, but let's pass the exact canvas coords and canvas size
                            return {
                                recipient_id: b.userId,
                                pos_x: b.x / scale,
                                pos_y: (viewport.height - b.y - 50) / scale, // 50 is box height
                                page_number: b.page
                            }
                        });
                        
                        fetch('/dms/signature/setup/save', {
                            method: 'POST',
                            headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
                            body: JSON.stringify({
                                params: {
                                    revision_id: revisionId,
                                    boxes: payload
                                }
                            })
                        }).then(response => response.json())
                          .then(data => {
                              if (data.result && data.result.success) {
                                  alert('Signature requests created successfully! You can close this window.');
                              } else {
                                  alert('An error occurred while saving.');
                              }
                          });
                    });
